Lead times are moderately unstable (CV=0.50, mean 2.42 days), contributing significantly to buffer requirements. The current SAP safety stock of 178 units is materially insufficient for the observed variability.

A continuous-review (r,Q) policy with EOQ-optimized fixed order quantity provides a practical balance between service level assurance and cost efficiency. The MOQ of 1,025 is below EOQ of 2,114, so EOQ governs without conflict.
